name: Generate images of DWI
summary: Generates a PNG of mid-axial, sagittal and coronal slices of a DWI image with FSL slicer, for quick visual quality control.
description: Runs FSL slicer -a on the input DWI image and writes raw/out.png. When the volume parameter is set, fslselectvols first extracts that volume from a 4D image; otherwise slicer renders the image as given. Use it for quick visual QA or for figures; it does not modify the data.

inputs.description: DWI image (NIfTI); bvecs and bvals are passed along but not used.

outputs.description: Directory with out.png, a mid-axial, sagittal and coronal slice montage of the DWI image.

parameters.description: Index of the volume to render from a 4D image (passed to fslselectvols --vols). Leave empty to render the image as given.
